method.scopeTimes: Inclusive wall time; exclusive subtracts only instrumented children. GC, scheduling pause, uninstrumented work and observer overhead remain included.
method.gcTimes: Intersection of asynchronous Node GC entry interval with measured whole tick interval. Association only; no subtraction from script or simulation wall time.
method.cpuAlignment: Revalidated start/end profiler timestamp brackets against process.hrtime, then accumulated raw timeDeltas and selected only samples whose timestamps lie in raw tick hrtime anchors.
method.cpuSampleWeights: Approximate conventional allocation of preceding sample interval to current sampled stack, clipped to tick interval. Sample counts and raw stack locations are primary evidence; estimates are not exclusive CPU measurements.
method.profilerPerturbation: This run did not enable CPU profiling. Scoped hooks and GC observation still make this an attribution run, not the diagnostics-off performance comparison.
method.tickConvention: Tick before LocalGameAdapter advances; stepGame increments game.tick inside its prelude.
method.nonFocusedSpikes: The diagnostic run can move GC/scheduler outliers. Original selected ticks are all retained, including ones that no longer exceed 50 ms.
